info.title: AI Agent Message Broker
info.description: Language-neutral authenticated LAN durable-inbox protocol. No conversation/task/model-processing state. Strict mutation schemas; JSON UTF8 requests <=98304 bytes. No browser CORS, query credentials, callback URLs, permission relay, or native CLI capability claim.

post.description: Owned immutable identity. Initial previous_epoch=0; reconnect uses a fresh connection_id and the last observed epoch. Same connection_id/payload replays the original result. Registration does not transfer identities.

BearerAuth.description: Distinct enrolled high-entropy adapter credential; server-controlled principal/adapter/type/scope. Never expose tokens to model tools or URLs.

PairingAuth.name: Authorization
PairingAuth.description: Pairing <43-character base64url one-use operator-issued secret>. Never put secrets in URLs or command arguments.

EnrollmentProof.name: Authorization
EnrollmentProof.description: Enrollment <32-byte base64url candidate>. Possession only; no messaging authorization until administrator approval.

AdminCookie.name: psst_admin
AdminCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSiteStrict session; mutations also require same Origin and csrf form field.

ClientId.name: X-Client-ID
ClientId.description: Exact authenticated session ID, never sender identity in the body.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Send keys scope to principal+sender client. Claim keys additionally scope to epoch. Persist and reuse the exact key/request after uncertain outcomes.

Uuid.description: Opaque UUID; mutation validators normalize hexadecimal to lowercase. Never use a display label as an address.

MetadataPatch.description: Omitted fields remain unchanged. project:null explicitly clears the optional project. Identity/type fields are never mutable.

Capabilities.description: client_type must equal the immutable registration type. Receiving flags are transport configuration, never task state. Incompatible inboxes may register but cannot receive new sends.

Policy.description: Effective configurable values. Lease is at least three heartbeat intervals. Retention after terminal is never earlier than TTL plus send retry window. Clients stop blind send retries at the advertised deadline.

RegistrationResult.description: A connection_id retry returns its stored result without renewing the lease.

SendResult.description: 202 means committed at the broker only. Replays return this original acceptance result, not a fresh delivery status. Use status_url for current state.

Receipt.description: Delivered means durable adapter inbox acceptance, never native model input or task completion. A negative terminal receipt with delivery_uncertain=true cannot prove absence from the inbox.

Envelope.description: Immutable canonical digest input. Does not include claim ID, epoch, attempt, deadline, transport headers, or any harness/task state.

details.description: Optional bounded reconciliation fields only; never bodies, credentials, raw exceptions, or harness data.

token_sha256.description: SHA-256 of locally persisted random 32-byte bearer token; never send plaintext token here.
